provenance: Measured over adb in the Phase 6 session. Values transcribed from the session output; the raw logcat files were kept in a temporary folder that macOS has since cleared.

checks.install_and_start: pass: both TFLite models load (XNNPACK); foreground service type microphone, ongoing notification
checks.screen_off_detection: pass for smoke_alarm and siren: alerted in every run with the display in DOZE (off); the full-screen alert turned the screen on
checks.swipe_from_recents: pass: app task removed, foreground service still running in the same process (pid 17134), inference continued
checks.no_audio_files: pass: 8 files in app private storage (Flutter engine data, graphics cache, 2 settings files), 0 audio files; no shared-storage folders
checks.settings_file_contents: alert history (label, confidence, time) and enabled classes only
checks.release_internet_permission: pass: release APK permissions = RECORD_AUDIO, FOREGROUND_SERVICE(_MICROPHONE), WAKE_LOCK, POST_NOTIFICATIONS, VIBRATE, USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT, Bluetooth; no INTERNET
checks.auto_restart: pass: after an app update the listening service restarted by itself (once; another time it did not)
checks.16kb_alignment: fixed: tensorflow-lite 2.16.1 libtensorflowlite_jni.so was 4 KB aligned; LiteRT 1.4.2 is 16 KB aligned

inference_ms_per_window.budget_note: a window is processed every 500 ms

speaker_playback_test.method: one held-out test clip per class (3 s silence + clip) played from the MacBook speakers at 70 % volume, phone next to the laptop; alerts from the app log
speaker_playback_test.interpretation: Small laptop speakers reproduce high-pitched alarms well but barely reproduce knocks, barks and doorbells; real sound sources are needed to judge those classes. UNPROCESSED audio is not supported on the S24; VOICE_RECOGNITION did slightly better than MIC.
speaker_playback_test.latency_note: Phone and Mac clocks were aligned over adb (tens of ms). The smoke alarm in its clip starts ~8.5 s in, so the phone alerted ~0.4 s after the pipeline expects; siren +1.5 s; appliance beep within the same window.

not_measured.battery_per_hour: needs the phone unplugged and listening for about an hour (pending)
not_measured.release_memory_and_latency: phone disconnected before the release-build run (pending)
not_measured.real_world_sources: doorbell, knocking, dog, glass and baby cry need real sounds (pending)
